subject: Scope document
text:
Hi,

I hope you are having a smooth start to the week. I am setting up the working folder for our new project and ran into a small technical issue while trying to match the file names to the task list. It is nothing serious, but it has left me unsure which version of the brief to use as the reference.

When you have a moment, could you please send the latest signed scope document as a PDF? I can work with a Word file as well, but the PDF would make it easier to check dates and headings. If there is already a version attached to an earlier email, just reply and include that attachment. I will archive the older one to avoid confusion.

While you look, please let me know if any dates in that document are provisional. If they are, I can mark them as tentative in the shared tracker. This will help me avoid scheduling a task around a milestone that might move.

I also want to keep our first payment milestone aligned with the approval step described in that document. If the sign-off is later than expected, I can pause the design review until I see the confirmed approval window. That way we avoid paying for a phase that has not been cleared.

Once I receive that file, I will update the task list and send you a summary for confirmation before beginning the first review round.

I appreciate your patience and help.

Many thanks,
